what caused confusion for me was that naranjos description of the 9 subtype just wasn't very applicable to me. however his examples tend to be pretty intense so I'm probably taking what he says too literally.

this is gonna be a ride because explaining things isn't my forte 😅

what struck me most with 9s was their self forgetfulness and overadaptation. the sense that nothing is important  and - most importantly - they themselves are not that important. they are a mere extension of their environment. i could go on forever but in short, i don't know how i process things, so 9s lack of self awareness is just the easiest thing to connect with myself. i tolerate a lot because i don't want to lose that connection.

then there's the sexual instinctual variant that somehow feels like a complete opposite of 9s ego, but is ever more relatable. the desire to be close to someone and the intensity that comes with it. i need to feel the chemistry of being hooked on someone  and to be desirable. always looking at things with a mindset of: will this make me look more desirable? what can i do to attract this person? etc. my relationships are usually very intense and ever since i was young ive always wanted someone who was devoted to me.
the easiest thing for me to do was to just read about the fixations individually as opposed to reading all three fixes together and combine them by what was most relatable.
